newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks drift lower in lacklustre London.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks drift lower in lacklustre London.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were slightly lower in London on Wednesday in thin and dull trading.
The Hang Seng London Reference index was down 3.06 points to 14,838.52 at 1313 GMT, having reached a high of 14,854.55 earlier.
"The market is just drifting lower, but there's no real trade happening," said one dealer.
He noted some activity in shares in HSBC Holdings, which rose as high as HK$230.00 at one stage, but slipped back to its Hong Kong closing levels.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index closed 71.41 points higher at 14,831.58.
